entries.dialogueText: "There are so many problems still to be solved in Sordland. Space is just a flashy distraction."

entries.dialogueText: "I agree with this plan in theory, but it would bankrupt our country in an instant."

entries.dialogueText: "I guess the USP has gotten it's hands on our new manifesto. In the new age nuclear power plays an important role. We need to position Sords as the dominant power in the region and our party is committed to such ends."
